trainer/31271-5.htm.text: Blacksmith Hilda: Do you have a request for Hilda? I can augment an item or remove augment.

trainer/31271-noteach.htm.text: Blacksmith Hilda: I'm a blacksmith! I only teach blacksmithing skills, such as artisan or warsmithing. If you don't want to be a blacksmith, go bother someone else!

Q00617_GatherTheFlames/31271-01.htm.text: Blacksmith Hilda: I've a tale to interest you. Have you heard tell of Vulcan , the blacksmith? Now, all us blacksmiths have much to say about fire — we depend on it for our livelihood. Vulcan, though, he spoke of nothing else, and his talk was the marvel of all who heard it. He said that the fire w…

Q00617_GatherTheFlames/31271-02.htm.text: Blacksmith Hilda: Ho, there! I'm Hilda the Blacksmith, and if you want good, solid work done, there's none better here. Don't pay any attention to the claims of that crackpot Vulcan . He's mad through and through. Fire is his obsession — he's forever searching for ways to make fire hotter and fierc…

Q00617_GatherTheFlames/31271-04.html.text: Blacksmith Hilda: So you met with Vulcan, did you? Did he give you an earful of his madness? Well, he's mad about flame, but the rewards he offers are real. Defeat the monsters in the Gods' Forge , collect the flames you find, and go to him; he will give you an S-grade weapon recipe if you bring hi…

Q00618_IntoTheFlame/31271-01.html.text: Blacksmith Hilda: Klein sent you here for a Vacualite, didn't he? ... I'm sorry, but I don't seem to have one at the moment. I could make one, however. You can get the ore. Bring me some Vacualite ore and I'll make a Vacualite for you.

Q00618_IntoTheFlame/31271-03.html.text: Blacksmith Hilda: You haven't brought enough! As I said, open the bellies of the Kookaburra, Bandersnatch and Grendel in the Garden of Wild Beasts. Sometimes their entrails contain Vacualite ore . This is probably due to their strange diet... Bring me 50 pieces of Vacualite ore and I'll make you a …

Q00618_IntoTheFlame/31271-04.html.text: Blacksmith Hilda: You've brought them all? Let me see! Excellent! I can get started on your Vacualite right away! Now, let me have that Vacualite ore...

Q00618_IntoTheFlame/31271-06.html.text: Blacksmith Hilda: Take the Vacualite to Klein .

Q00617_GatherTheFlames/31271-03.htm.text: Blacksmith Hilda: Very well, then. Defeat the monsters in the Gods' Forge , collect the flames you find there, and bring them to Vulcan. He's mad, but he's a canny blacksmith; he'll give you an S-grade weapon recipe if you can bring him 1000 flames . You may have heard tell of Vulcan's younger brot…

Q00618_IntoTheFlame/31271-02.html.text: Blacksmith Hilda: Open the bellies of the Kookaburra, Bandersnatch and Grendel in the Garden of Wild Beasts. Occasionally their entrails contain Vacualite ore . It's probably due to their bizarre diet! Bring 50 pieces of Vacualite ore to me and I'll make a Vacualite for you.

Q00618_IntoTheFlame/31271-05.html.text: Blacksmith Hilda: Where should I begin? First I must melt it in the furnace to separate the impurities and extract pure Vacualite. Then, once cooled... It's done! Here it is! Take this Vacualite to Klein .

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
